features.title: Verify init.sh runs cleanly
features.user_visible_behavior: Running ./init.sh from a clean checkout installs deps, runs verification, and prints the start command without errors.
verification: cd into this repo from a clean checkout
Confirm install, verify, and start-command-print steps all succeed
If anything fails, edit init.sh and re-run
features.notes: Inferred commands: install='go mod download', verify='go build ./...', start='(cd cmd/gateway && go run .)'. Gateway needs FoundationDB client libs (v6.2.27). Runtime requires Redis + etcd + Discord TOKEN. The verify command runs a build only — full tests require infra.

features.title: Backfill-completion marker for RGM skip
features.user_visible_behavior: On reconnect, the gateway can force a targeted shard to IDENTIFY and then skip Request Guild Members for guilds with completed backfill markers, reconciles small guilds straight from the GUILD_CREATE payload, and removes ghost members who left while disconnected — instead of re-requesting every guild's members on every connect.
verification: go test ./discord/... ./internal/gatewayws/... (PASS — decoder field tests, membersComplete, jitterFactor)
go test ./internal/state/db/statepsql/ -run 'Backfill|Reconcile|Complete' (4/4 PASS against live PostgreSQL 14)
go test ./internal/gatewayws ./gatewaypb ./internal/manager (PASS — force-identify session behavior and protobuf flag round-trip; manager compiles)
PENDING: staging deploy via helm + end-to-end check of real chunk decode, preload, and reconnect read volume
evidence: 2026-06-18: build/vet clean; all unit tests pass; 4 statepsql marker tests pass against local-stack PG14 (guild_backfills created in the state DB). Integration run caught and fixed an app-clock vs DB-clock test-seeding bug.

2026-06-18: added surgical per-shard force-identify through RestartShardRequest.force_identify; verified with ./init.sh, go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./internal/gatewayws ./gatewaypb ./internal/manager, and go test ./discord/... ./internal/gatewayws/... ./gatewaypb.
features.notes: Implemented on master baseline (not on feat/gate-rgm-on-reidentify, which it supersedes). 2026-06-18 pivot: skip is now NO-EXPIRY (skip if backfilled_at IS NOT NULL, any age) because reconnect-storm speed is the priority — a jittered staleness skip gave no relief for the storm-after-long-uptime case it most needs to help. Drift is bounded by the reconciliation delete on real backfills + cold re-backfills on UNLOGGED cache reset; it only accrues during disconnect windows, so good uptime keeps it small. A Phase 3b background sweep is DEFERRED/OPTIONAL (build only if roster staleness becomes a real complaint), not required. 2026-06-18 force-identify control: RestartShardRequest.force_identify clears and persists the target shard's resume tuple in-process before canceling that shard, avoiding DB-delete/pod-shutdown races and avoiding a 64-shard pod restart. Status stays in_progress until staging validation runs; per Definition of Done a feature is 'passing' only after the required end-to-end verification actually runs. Apply guild_backfills (init.sql, IF NOT EXISTS) to the staging state DB before deploy.
